# Court Gems

> Court Gems is a small London-based tennis accessories brand. It sells characterful silicone racket vibration dampeners, synthetic overgrips and tennis gift sets online at https://courtgems.co.uk (UK, prices in GBP) and on Etsy.

## About

Court Gems makes small tennis accessories with personality: playful dampener designs with names like Caught Slippin', Yes You Can and Trust The Process, sold in holographic pouches on a lilac backing card. The brand is aimed at recreational and club players, and at people buying an affordable tennis gift. Designs are created in London.

A vibration dampener sits between the main strings of a tennis racket. It softens the string vibration a player feels and quietens the "ping" sound off the strings. It does not add power or spin.

## Gift sets

- **The ATP Blue Set** (£15.99): 3 ATP Blue overgrips and a Smiley Days dampener 2-pack.
- **The Championship White Set** (£15.99): 3 Wimbledon White overgrips and a Trust The Process Championship Whites dampener 2-pack.
- **All Stars Pack** (£17.99): 4 dampeners in one holographic pouch: Caught Slippin', Sweet & Sassy, Go With The Flow and Yes You Can.

## Dampeners (2-packs, £7.99)

Every design comes as a pair: two 3g silicone dampeners in a resealable holographic pouch.

- **Caught Slippin'**: a banana-peel design. Editions: Navy, Grass Season (limited edition).
- **Trust The Process**: lettering with small stars. Editions: Championship Whites, Black.
- **Smiley Days**: a wavy, melting smiley face in sky blue.
- **Yeehaw**: a pink cowgirl hat covered in stars.
- **Yes You Can**: pep-talk lettering. Editions: Summer Slam (orange), Navy.
- **Self Love Club**: deep green lettering on mint.
- **Sweet & Sassy**: a heart with a smile. Editions: Lavender, Pink.
- **Go With The Flow**: wavy yellow lettering on dark green.

## Overgrips (3-packs, £11.99)

Soft, tacky synthetic overgrips, three to a pack in a clear zip pouch. Colours: Wimbledon White, Indian Wells Edition (lavender), ATP Blue.

## Fit and match play

- The dampeners fit standard strung tennis rackets, adult or junior.
- To fit one, squeeze it between two main strings just below the last cross string at the bottom of the string bed.
- In that position it sits outside the pattern of crossed strings, which tennis rules allow, so it can be used in matches.

## Good for

- Tennis gifts under £20: birthdays, Christmas, Secret Santa, stocking fillers, doubles partners, coaches and club prizes.
- Personalising a racket, or telling rackets apart in a kit bag.

## Delivery and returns

- UK delivery only. Standard £4.99, free on orders over £50; Express £6.99. Orders dispatch within 1–2 working days.
- Christmas: order by 14 December (Standard) or 17 December (Express).
- Returns: unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Faulty or damaged items are replaced or refunded, postage included.
- Details: https://courtgems.co.uk/delivery/ and https://courtgems.co.uk/returns/
